sourceTitle: U.S. Census Bureau, 2022 Statistics of U.S. Businesses
basis: U.S. 10–499 employee firms only. Excludes firms below 10 employees, firms at 500+ employees and international markets. Employee range is a conservative sizing boundary, not a new customer minimum or pricing rule.
samLimit: NAICS 54 is a measurable proxy for the professional-services starting market. Firm counts do not establish budget, purchase intent, supported integrations or deployment eligibility. SAM is a population-based spending envelope at the current standard price, subject to qualification.
somLimit: SOM is the existing 18-month operating-plan scenario after churn, not a market-share assumption or achieved revenue. No change to hiring, acquisition, pricing or churn assumptions. The existing company plan is not allocated by NAICS sector; its sector mix and professional-services sales conversion are untested.
